verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 4f12a87b5f1e5e440fdf1bf1231450002657fba9 records a bounded WYSIWYG gate definition. RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/wysiwygGate.test.ts failing because docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-editor-wysiwyg-gate-design.md did not exist and the WYSIWYG gate exports were undefined. GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- src/tests/wysiwygGate.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts with 2 files and 7 tests, npm run test -- src/tests/wysiwygGate.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/editorLargeStructurePerformance.test.ts with 5 files and 23 tests, npm run type-check, and npm run check in the Editor worktree with 109 test files, 395 tests, and build. Merged Editor main passed npm run check with 109 test files, 395 tests, and build. The spec states FlowDoc WYSIWYG means managed document-surface authoring, preserves Hybrid Managed Cards + one Active Text-Block Island as the accepted direction, states the bounded textarea active text-block island is not WYSIWYG, states Full-document contenteditable is out of scope, and states History, Overview, Structure, and Preview are not WYSIWYG by themselves. resolveWysiwygGateDecision records WYSIWYG behavior categories, non-WYSIWYG behaviors, required entry prerequisites, contenteditable blocking, rich editor engine package blocking for Slate/ProseMirror/TipTap-style packages, and keeps activeTextInputBinding as textarea. Project Control RED evidence included npm test -- tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --maxWorkers=4 failing before this phase/evidence was registered. Project Control GREEN evidence passed the same focused roadmap test with 1 file and 2 tests. Combined npm run check in the Project Control worktree repeatedly hit Vitest fork worker timeouts in app-jsdom, so the worktree verification used the split gate: npm run check:data, npm run type-check, npx vitest run --exclude tests/e2e/** --project=node --maxWorkers=1 with 52 files and 276 tests, npx vitest run --exclude tests/e2e/** --project=app-jsdom --maxWorkers=1 with 7 files and 54 tests, npm run build, and npm run test:e2e with 6 Playwright e2e tests. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, DOM innerHTML document truth, ProseMirror, Slate, TipTap, direct preview typing, table/cell surface editing, media authoring, visible UI behavior changes, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity audit findings and Vite retains the existing chunk-size warning. The Editor branch fd-ed-wysiwyg-gate-0831 was deleted after merge; Git no longer lists C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/flowdoc-vnext-editor/.worktrees/fd-ed-wysiwyg-gate-0831 as a worktree, but that residual folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Directory not empty and direct recursive deletion was intentionally avoided because dependency links have previously caused cleanup risk. Project Control baseline npm run check hit Vitest fork worker start timeouts and one silent runner crash before record edits; split verification passed, so this remains tracked as intermittent runner infrastructure risk rather than a Project Control data failure.
